decision.reason: [ev-7a3fdefaaff7] only says "the service account template" was fixed to handle boolean annotation values. It doesn't name a values key, and it doesn't say which of the chart's service account templates changed, so the subject path serviceAccount.annotations can't be confirmed from the evidence. The values validator was inconclusive: the key isn't in the chart's default values, only its parent section is. A behavior-changed type is plausible for a bugfix, but without the PR #7698 diff or the affected template and values key, neither the subject nor the change can be settled.
